newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - JLK Direct Distribution Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - JLK Direct Distribution Inc.

text.p: JLK Direct Distribution Inc, a unit of Kennametal Inc, said Monday it filed an initial public offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer about $100 million worth of Class A stock.

The company said it will use the proceeds to repay debt related to a dividend paid to Kennametal on April 28, to construct a new midwest distribution center and provide working capital for new showrooms, among others.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co and Goldman Sachs & Co, the company said. Kennametal will continue to own all the Class B.
The company, based in Latrobe, Pa., is a supplier of a broad range of metalworking consumables and related products to customers in the United States.
